name: Dong Feng Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dong Feng Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts and accessories in China. The company operates in two segments: Automobile and Motorcycle Parts Production and Sales; and House Rental. The company offers automobile interior and exterior trim parts, automobile braking systems, die castings, thermostat systems, etc. It also provides covering cockpit and body systems, braking and intelligent driving system, electric drive system, thermal management system, and powertrain component system, as well as engages in house leasing activities.
